summary: Adversarial verification of architecture-global. 22 findings: 9 confirmed, 13 adjusted, 0 fully refuted (several sub-claims refuted inside adjusted items). 30 proposed splits: 16 confirmed, 14 adjusted. Key corrections implementers must apply: (1) storage->controller edge is TEST-ONLY (storage/bookmarks.rs:89 inside cfg(test) mod at 81), not a production violation. (2) Moving controller/state to src/state/ first would create a state<->controller cycle: production controller code (command.rs:42, event.rs:327/331, app_controller.rs:48/293) imports state::MixerAudioRequest, and state imports controller::event/command/workspace::unix_ms. Required order: finding 08 step 1 + 05 + 06 BEFORE 01. (3) Moving state out of controller/ drops existing GTK-ban coverage; add violations("state", ...) to background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui in the same PR. (4) chart.rs Severity is not a duplicate of DiagnosticSeverity. (5) action_catalog production is 666 lines and only 35-65 + 148-288 is resolution logic. (6) SCENEDECK_MIXER_INSPECT is a documented manual-test diagnostic; do not cfg-gate it. (7) Poison-recovery for lifecycle mutexes is a semantic change, not a mechanical move. (8) NavigationContext::update must not silently drop writes. Self-review only: no independent reviewer agent was spawned; all checks done by direct reads and greps at HEAD 31d512f.

findings.title: AppState is a cross-context god aggregate (47 fields, ~745-line impl) living in the controller layer
findings.recommendation: 1) Land finding 08 step 1 (move MixerAudioRequest out of controller/state/mixer.rs) and finding 06 (unix_ms to infra/clock.rs) and finding 05 (ConnectionInfo to domain) BEFORE moving state. 2) git mv controller/state.rs + controller/state/ to src/state/ with a temporary `pub(crate) use crate::state;` shim in controller/mod.rs. 3) In the SAME PR extend architecture_tests.rs `background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui` with `violations("state", &forbidden, &[])` so AppState stays GTK-free (today it is guarded only because it sits under controller/). 4) Split into slices one per PR (outputs, stats, topology, session, audio, operating, curation, navigation) with private fields + intent methods; keep delegating methods on AppState for one PR. 5) Move Page::title/icon_name, ObsStatus::label/css_class, TopologyStatus::notice to ui (e.g. src/ui/l10n/state_labels.rs). Note: state will still depend on controller::event::AppEvent and controller::command::AppCommand (note_command_intent 566-571, apply_output_event 641-646); that direction (state -> controller messages) is acceptable but AT-6 (controller !-> state) can only land after MixerAudioRequest leaves state.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: struct AppState 438-499 has 47 fields (not ~50), WorkspaceState 193-229 has 31 fields; impl 501-1246; cfg(test) at 1247. Presentation methods confirmed at 65 (title), 106 (label), 115 (css_class), 138 (notice). Claim 'Tokio-side controller never touches AppState' holds for AppState itself (app_controller.rs:713-731 and output_controller.rs:643 are tests), BUT production controller code imports the state module: command.rs:42 and event.rs:327/331 and app_controller.rs:48/293 use crate::controller::state::MixerAudioRequest. And state imports controller internals in production: controller::event (4, 643, 753), controller::command (568), controller::workspace::unix_ms (758, 835, 854, 932; state/bookmarks.rs:84; state/session_reports.rs:66/120/213). Moving state out first would create a state<->controller cycle at module level and AT-6 would fail immediately. Also moving out of controller/ silently drops the existing GTK-ban coverage (architecture_tests.rs:669-681 only scans controller/storage/obs). Dependencies and order fixed accordingly.
